PCA_weights: inherited RELEASE area_per_gt: core patch area divided by its reference-row count; unowned rows weight zero; record these counts; all scene rows of requested case, no feature subset
ranking: all earlier methods may trail any later method by at most 1 percentage point; prefer rank-passing candidates; minimize sum absolute gaps from rounded ordered targets; tie most case points, then deterministic candidate id

roof_boundary.definition: Prior roof mesh faces under frozen 75deg/1m rule; group roof patches by exact inherited core building identity (source_index), joining roof tiers of the same building and separating adjacent buildings. Only unnamed patches use 3D 0.6m components. Endpoints are the exact prior roof center-plane intersection extrema plus 1m, not footprint edges.
roof_boundary.reason: XY connectivity joined neighboring buildings; 3D connectivity split roof tiers. Reuse existing stable building identity for grouping only; selection count/rank/score rules remain unchanged.
roof_boundary.roof_group_space: inherited building identity plus GroundSurface XY identity fallback
roof_boundary.unknown_identity: For unnamed prior patches, use shared GroundSurface XY buffered 1m for identity only; resolve overlaps by nearest existing prior roof support in 3D. Unresolved patches cannot define a building-wide candidate. No ground or roof Z/edge is substituted for prior mesh endpoints.

c3_camera.occluder_policy: remove only full original triangles hit before the target roof by camera-to-target rays; record exact face ids and source hashes; no replacement triangles

precision.population: same inherited stage1 sample_reference_row case bins and sample_eligible; use saved sample_s/sample_tau without rescoring
precision.nearest_reference: nearest 3D scoring row for feature/LGDM-absence split; separately retain inherited same-owner assignment for per-case population
precision.feature_source: addendum4 expanded features; preserve unavailable quadrant -2 separately

undefined_fallback: If no min-count candidate exists, report unavailable; do not lower the count. Keep rank fallback as expressly ordered.
